SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: MANAGEMENT BELIEVES THAT IT HAS APPROPRIATE SUPPORT FOR ANY TAX POSITIONS TAKEN, AND AS SUCH, DOES NOT HAVE ANY UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS THAT ARE MATERIAL TO THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS. LIVE OAK'S FEDERAL AND STATE INFORMATION RETURNS FOR THE YEARS 2021 THROUGH 2024 ARE SUBJECT TO EXAMINATION BY REGULATORY AGENCIES, GENERALLY FOR THREE YEARS AND FOUR YEARS AFTER THEY WERE FILED FOR FEDERAL AND STATE, RESPECTIVELY.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: GENERALLY, ADJUSTED TUITION AWARDS CONSTITUTE A REDUCTION IN TUITION AND A REDUCTION IN THE COST OF ACTIVITIES, RATHER THAN A CASH AWARD, SO IT CAN ONLY BE USED FOR THE INTENDED PURPOSE.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: PART III, COLUMN (F) DESCRIPTION OF NON-CASH ASSISTANCE :
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: LIVE OAK SCHOOL'S ADJUSTED TUITION PROGRAM ENABLES FAMILIES OF MANY SOCIO-ECONOMIC BACKGROUNDS TO AFFORD A LIVE OAK EDUCATION. TO PARTICIPATE IN THE ADJUSTED TUITION PROGRAM, FAMILIES SUBMIT THEIR HOUSEHOLD FINANCIAL INFORMATION THROUGH A THIRD PARTY VENDOR. THE INFORMATION, INCLUDING TAX RETURNS, IS REVIEWED BY A COMMITTEE AND AN AFFORDABLE TUITION LEVEL IS SET FOR THE FAMILY. THE ADJUSTED TUITION PROGRAM COVERS TUITION, EXTENDED DAY PROGRAM FEES, AND LEARNING SERVICES/SUPPORT.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: SCHEDULE K, PART I TO V:
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: BEGINNING OF 2015-16 IT WAS THE ORGANIZATION'S INTERPRETATION AT THE TIME, THAT THE TAX-EXEMPT BOND WOULD BE TREATED AS A NOTE HELD BY THE COMMERCIAL LENDER, FIRST REPUBLIC BANK. STARTING 2019-20, THE ORGANIZATION HAS DECIDED IT WOULD BE APPROPRIATE TO DISCLOSE THE NOTE AS A TAX-EXEMPT BOND AND REPORT ALL REQUIRED INFORMATION ON FORM 990 AND SCHEDULE K.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE COMPENSATION COMMITTEE (4 TRUSTEES) WORKED WITH A CONSULTANT IN ORDER TO COMPARE THE EXISTING EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT FOR THE HEAD OF SCHOOL TO INDUSTRY AND LOCAL INDEPENDENT SCHOOL BENCHMARKS. BASED ON THE WORK WITH THE CONSULTANT, THE LIVE OAK BOARD OF TRUSTEES AND THE HEAD OF SCHOOL ENTERED INTO A NEW 5-YEAR CONTRACT THAT BEGAN ON JULY 1, 2022 AND RUNS THROUGH JUNE 30, 2027. COMPENSATION FOR THE CFO IS DETERMINED THROUGH BENCHMARKING AGAINST PEER SCHOOLS IN THE MARKET ALONG WITH INPUT FROM INDEPENDENT CONSULTANTS WITH COMPENSATION EXPERTISE.
